mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM chat_rooms r JOIN chat_room_members m ON r.room_id = m.room_id WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT crm.*, m.nickname, m.profile_image FROM chat_room_members crm JOIN members m ON crm.member_id = m.member_id WHERE crm.room_id = #{roomId}

SELECT r.room_id FROM ( SELECT room_id FROM chat_room_members WHERE member_id IN (#{memberId1}, #{memberId2}) GROUP BY room_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) = 2 ) t JOIN chat_rooms r ON t.room_id = r.room_id WHERE r.room_type = 'PERSONAL' AND ROWNUM = 1
